{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > /tmp/conv_phase.md <<'EOF'

## Phase 3: Convergence

Convergence assessment (2026-10-16): FR-001..FR-005 and SC-001/SC-003/SC-004 verified
satisfied (smoke.py add(a,b) returns a+b; 9/9 target tests and 232/232 full-suite
tests pass with exit 0; tinydb/ unmodified per git status; no new dependencies or
service files). One gap found: FR-006/SC-002 (runnable by the project's existing
test runner) does not hold verbatim in this environment: pytest.ini addopts
(--cov-append --cov-report term --cov tinydb) require pytest-cov, which is not
installed, so bare `python3 -m pytest` exits 4 before collection (pre-existing
condition affecting the whole suite, not smoke-specific).

- [ ] T012 [P] Document the FR-006/SC-002 runner gap (pytest.ini --cov addopts require pytest-cov; pytest-cov absent; bare python3 -m pytest exits 4 pre-collection; pre-existing repo condition) in specs/001-transactions/research.md as a short Open Gaps note, including the verified workaround invocation `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -o addopts="" tests/test_smoke.py` (9 passed, exit 0) and full-suite `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -o addopts=""` (232 passed, exit 0) (partial)
- [ ] T013 [P] Re-verify after T012: confirm specs/001-transactions/research.md contains the Open Gaps note, tasks.md remains append-only (11 prior tasks unchanged and checked), and `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -o addopts=""` still reports 232 passed exit 0 (partial)
EOF
wc -l /tmp/conv_phase.md && cat /tmp/conv_phase.md"}
